## 1. The Evening After South Cerney Lakes – Piano Surprise & Aero Reveal
They returned home after the long, chaotic day at South Cerney lakes. Scarlett had secretly arranged for the Steinway Model A grand piano to be delivered and installed while Benjamin was at work — a surprise she had been planning for weeks.
They sat down together and played a joyful, emotional four-hands version of Brahms Hungarian Dances. They laughed, bumped shoulders, and snorted with affection. Benjamin then discovered the aftermarket Steingraeber silent system Scarlett had secretly had fitted that same day. He tried it with headphones, loaded the Yamaha CFX library, and was stunned into silence by how real it sounded.
He stood up, walked straight to Scarlett, and kissed her deeply.
They curled up on the sofa together, city lights twinkling outside. Benjamin then revealed the secret project he had been working on for weeks: a full custom aero package for the Black Panther.
He had 3D-scanned the entire car while Scarlett was asleep and used advanced AI + computational fluid dynamics to design multiple versions. He tested 25 different bonnets. The package includes a high-downforce track version and a low-downforce high-speed version (~290 mph autobahn target). It uses fully modular, non-invasive carbon fibre panels in the exact same weave and colour as the original car, with gold and black accents and the yellow “Pantera eye” motif. Optional embossing: “S. Akerlund [SE]” with a small Swedish flag. A small hidden Star of Ishtar symbol can be laser-etched inside the fuel filler flap.
Scarlett was overwhelmed. She cried. She immediately accepted both versions and started planning a trip to AMG in Germany. She chose three favourite bonnets and asked for the full modular set.
